text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In that race, Sakura Laurel was indisputably the first favorite.
And from her third-place position, she—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“She's not accelerating! Sakura Laurel!
Sakura Laurel is slowing down at an alarming rate!
What happened?! The lead remains unchanged—”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Haah... haah...
Trainer...-san..."

text_block_list.name: Local Staff
text_block_list.text:
"‘Hurry, get a stretcher!
Are you her Trainer?!’"

text_block_list.name: Local Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Stay calm!
We need to treat this immediately!"

text_block_list.name: Local Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Get to a hospital, now!
Otherwise, it won't just be her leg—she could lose her life...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I studied French little by little,
I gradually began to understand
the conversation from that nightmare.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, the substance of the matter itself remained unchanged...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally here! It's almost time!
Our debut race is upon us,
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Are you okay?
Is something bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Have you been sleeping well at night?
The dark circles under your eyes look terrible.
choice_data_list: I-It's just a coincidence! Because the race is coming up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
......
You're right, my debut race is just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The debut race.
I had registered Sakura Laurel
for the turf course.
choice_data_list: (There's no problem in terms of aptitude, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Turf has a higher rebound force than dirt.
Therefore, the burden placed on the legs is greater."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, some data indicated that
the injury rate is actually higher on dirt tracks.
choice_data_list: (I wonder which choice was the right one...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Are you really all right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Alright then,
shall we begin our training?
choice_data_list: Yeah, but let's wrap up a little earlier than planned.
Yeah, but let's wrap up earlier than planned.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh, even though it's almost time for the real thing?
choice_data_list: With the real race so close, I don't want to carry any fatigue into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Any risk factors that could lead to injury
ought to be eliminated as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came the day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Outfit, check. Strategy review, all good.
Trainer, I'm all set.
choice_data_list: I see. Are the horseshoes looking good too?
Right, do your horseshoes look okay too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. How many times do you think
we've had this exact exchange since morning?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm actually surprisingly good at self-management, you know.
Trainer-san, you should know that by now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Sakura Laurel said,
she is quite dependable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She never makes careless mistakes, nor have I ever seen her let her emotions take over and push her body past its limits during training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, this is your first official race.
The lineup and intensity will be completely different."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even for Sakura Laurel, who had always held back
during training to avoid injuring her legs,
anything could happen—
choice_data_list: ...Just make sure you don't overdo it.
...Just make sure you don't overdo it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...You're definitely acting strange, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you afraid?
...Afraid of my race?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Are you afraid that one day
I might suffer a terrible injury?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...If you don't answer me right away,
I'm gonna take that as a yes, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well then, let's take a deep breath!
Ready, set, go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Are your shoulders still tensed up?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fear stiffens both body and mind.
Desperately trying to keep
precious things away from harm.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Still, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The reason I teamed up with you was not so you could protect me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: It's so that I can dream alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Even with a handicap, to make our big dream come true...
I want to reach out side-by-side with you."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: So Trainer, please keep your eyes on my running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: How I run as I dash through my debut race.
